title: 卡蜜尔·钟表花
description: 银发卡蜜尔穿利落高领长装，坐在高椅上照看一朵机械小花，标志刃足稳放地面。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Camille is an elegant older woman with a sharp silver bob, pale blue mechanical eyes, angular cheek details, and a precise upright bearing. Keep her long dark high-collared fitted coat and fully covering leg structure recognizable. Her distinctive elongated mechanical blade legs remain attached but rest flat and inactive on the floor, with softened crayon edges and clearly articulated hip joints.
art_direction.scene: She sits carefully on a sturdy high-backed chair, using a tiny cloth to polish one petal of a small clockwork flower in a pot. A plain gear-shaped coaster and a round window echo the mechanical theme. Her blade feet remain visibly grounded and separated, while her expression softens toward the delicate little object.
art_direction.palette: silver gray, midnight navy, ice blue, soft brass
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
